title: Finite affine restrictions detect equality after base change
statement: Let S be a qcqs scheme and W an etale object over S with qcqs structure map. There exists a finite family Vₐ → W of etale objects over S with affine domains and qcqs structure maps. For every scheme T, morphism h : T → S, sheaf F of sets on the small etale site of T, and sections s,t on h*W, equality of their restrictions to each h*Vₐ implies s=t. The family may be empty for empty W.

proof.text: Use QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace to make W quasi-compact. Take Scheme.OpenCover.finiteSubcover of its canonical affine cover and reindex by Fin using Fintype.equivFin. Compose its open immersions with W → S to obtain the etale objects and arrows. Affine sources are compact and quasi-separated, so quasiCompact_of_compactSpace and QuasiSeparated.of_quasiSeparatedSpace give their qcqs structure maps.

Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff turns the union-of-ranges equation of the finite open cover into a covering sieve. The proved upstream Scheme.coverPreserving_overPullback sends it to a covering sieve on T; Sieve.functorPushforward_ofArrows identifies its arrows. Apply Presheaf.IsSheaf.hom_ext_ofArrows to the two maps from PUnit given by s and t. The assumed restriction equations identify these maps on each covering arrow; evaluation at PUnit.unit gives s=t, including the empty covering.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_finite_affine_restriction_detection
    {S : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    (W : S.Etale) [QuasiCompact W.hom] [QuasiSeparated W.hom] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → S.Etale) (v : ∀ a, V a ⟶ W),
      (∀ a, IsAffine (V a).left) ∧
      (∀ a, QuasiCompact (V a).hom) ∧
      (∀ a, QuasiSeparated (V a).hom) ∧
      ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ S)
        (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
        (s t : F.obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).obj W))),
        (∀ a, F.obj.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).map (v a)).op s =
          F.obj.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).map (v a)).op t) →
        s = t
